summary.text: Gayle Pezzo is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-20 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Gayle Pezzo was born in Long Beach, New York, and graduated from Molloy College.
Her career experience includes working as a community organizer.
Pezzo assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
